title: Stopwatch with cleanup
summary: Start and stop an interval in an effect, with cleanup and updater functions.
prompt: Finish `Stopwatch`. "Start" begins counting ticks every `intervalMs` (default 1000) and turns into "Stop". "Stop" pauses. "Reset" sets the count to 0. Show the count in `data-testid="elapsed"`. The interval must be cleared on stop and on unmount.
hints: Run the effect when `running` changes, and return `() => clearInterval(id)` from it.
Inside the interval, use `setTicks(t => t + 1)`. A plain `ticks + 1` would read a stale closure.
